# SPACE-TR (SPACE)

> SPACE-TR, also known as SPACE, is a specialist B2B fragrance distributor connecting international perfume houses with retailers and consumers across African markets.

Space supports international fragrance houses through market strategy, selective distribution, travel retail, brand stewardship, retail excellence, training, warehousing and cross-border logistics. The business operates across 20+ African markets with 50+ brand partners and 4,800+ available SKUs. Maven Global is Space's regional subsidiary in Kenya, with local distribution infrastructure and consumer retail through FeelNzuri in Nairobi.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.space-tr.com/en/): Company overview, geographic reach, brand portfolio and leadership team.
- [About Space](https://www.space-tr.com/en/about-space.html): Company history, market footprint and operating model.
- [Expertise](https://www.space-tr.com/en/expertise.html): Market strategy, sales and distribution, operations and logistics, brand stewardship, marketing activation, retail excellence and training.
- [FeelNzuri](https://www.space-tr.com/en/feelnzuri.html): Maven's niche fragrance lounge in Nairobi.
- [Careers](https://www.space-tr.com/en/careers.html): Current opportunities published by Space.
- [Insights](https://www.space-tr.com/en/posts.html): Published articles and company perspectives.
- [French site](https://www.space-tr.com/fr/): French-language company website.

## Usage notes

- Treat the English and French pages as language equivalents.
- Use the canonical URLs shown above when citing Space.
- Current jobs and articles are published dynamically and included in the XML sitemap.
- A brand appearing in the public portfolio does not by itself establish exclusivity, territory or a specific contractual relationship.
